name: Trap
description: A tight cluster of islands that rewards patience and punishes anyone who pushes in blind.

keyAreas.name: Point A
keyAreas.notes: Tucked near islands. Easy to contest under cover, but also easy to get boxed in.

keyAreas.name: Point B (center)
keyAreas.notes: Wide open relative to the rest of the map. Taking it exposes you to multiple angles at once.

keyAreas.name: Point C
keyAreas.notes: Mirror of Point A on the opposite side. Same cover, same risk of getting pinned.

keyAreas.name: Central island cluster
keyAreas.notes: A popular spot for cruisers and battleships to sit and peek. Expect return fire the moment you show broadside.

keyAreas.name: Narrow channel between islands
keyAreas.notes: Great for ambushing destroyers, bad to get caught in against multiple opponents.

keyAreas.name: Outer edges
keyAreas.notes: Less contested early. A good route for destroyers to slip past the main clash.

strategyNotes: Islands make this a good map for destroyers to ambush from concealment. Use them.
Battleships should avoid sitting still in the open near the center point. The island clusters offer much safer firing angles.
Don't fully commit to one capture point early. The layout makes it easy to get flanked from a route you didn't expect.
